outcome.technical: Fixes R37 (med) and R38 (low) in tools/reach-diff.py. (a) New `refusal_sites(source)` walks the module's own AST (every top-level statement above the `# --- selftest` mark, plus the __main__ block) and collects the name literal at every `_refuse(...)` call and every `_refusal(...)` call; a non-literal name (other than `<x>.name`, a Refusal passed on) or a `Refusal(...)` built outside `_refusal` is reported as unnamed; a source without the selftest mark reports scanned=False instead of clean. The hand-built `(name, why)` tuples in `_prepare`, `_recheck_refusal` and `_judge`'s recheck-export are gone: each is now `_refusal(name, why)`, which returns a namedtuple `Refusal` and checks the name against REFUSALS at construction; the forward sites read `.name`/`.why`, so a hand-built pair cannot print. (b) The same walk reports any `return 1|2` literal, `sys.exit/os._exit/exit/quit/SystemExit` with a 1/2 literal, and any write of 1/2 under a `code` key (subscript, dict literal, `code=` keyword) outside `_CODE_WRITERS` = {2: fresh_result, _refuse; 1: _judge}. main's bare `return 2` (usage) and `return 0` (help) were removed: `_command(argv, out)` returns a result and `main` reads the code only through `settle(result, out)`, which refuses as `internal` a 2 naming no refusal, a 1 with no line lost, or a code EXIT CODES does not state. (c) `main(argv, out=None, run=None)` catches Exception from the run and refuses `internal`, printing the traceback, so 1 means only a line lost (R38). Docstring: contract sentence extended to say sites are read off the syntax tree and the exit rules; EXIT CODES sentence for 1; new `[internal]` list entry. CONTRIBUTING.md: the restated selftest sentence removed, replaced by a pointer that the holding is stated in --help. Cases added rd64-rd72 (rd64 own source clean both ways; rd65 unreached unlisted name read at _refuse and _refusal; rd66 non-literal name/Refusal bypass; rd67 seven exit shapes; rd68 region boundary and no-mark; rd69 raise and unlisted-name ValueError -> exit 2 internal with traceback; rd70 unnamed 2; rd71 1 with no gaps; rd72 the allow direction). Mutation probe <scratchpad>/probe/mutations.py (anchor count asserted ==1, landed-assert, __pycache__ purged, restored in finally, byte-identical restore asserted; probe exit 0): unreached unlisted `_refuse` site -> rd64 FAIL; bare `return 2` -> rd64/67/68 FAIL; settle's unnamed-2 branch dropped -> rd70 FAIL; raise inside compare -> CLI `--base HEAD --head WORKTREE` exit 2 with '(internal) - RuntimeError ...' and traceback; main's catch narrowed -> rd69 FAIL; over-fire settle refusing every 1 -> rd72 FAIL; over-fire _CODE_WRITERS emptied -> rd64 FAIL. Final: `python3 tools/reach-diff.py --selftest` ALL PASS 80/80; `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tools/reach-diff.py tests/test__output_lints.py tests/test__deps.py tests/test__refs.py` exit 0, 4/4 files ok, 820 cases; `ruff check tools/reach-diff.py` pass; `vermin -t=3.8-` on the file exit 0. Dependants: CONTRIBUTING.md still names `tools/reach-diff.py --help` correctly (changed: pointer only); hook_line (tests/test__refs.py), parse_args, total, compare unchanged in name and signature; main gained an optional `run` keyword, positional use unchanged; the CONTRIBUTING basename referrers are untouched by a one-paragraph edit and test__deps/test__output_lints/test__refs are green over it. No commit, stash or add.
outcome.descriptive: reach-diff's refusal and exit-code contract is now held by a walk of its own source plus a single settling point in main, so an unreached unlisted refusal, a bare exit-2/exit-1 path, or an unexpected exception can no longer slip past --selftest or exit 1.
